reproducedBeforeFix.observed: Pointer lock CANVAS acquired; simulationState stayed 'ready', tick 0; W held 1 s, mouse moved and canvas clicked -> listener [0,1.6,4] and orientation unchanged; only an extra Enter started motion (tick 27 -> W moved z 4 -> 2.403).

rootCause: After a successful entry the host stayed suspended and the UI dropped every look/move/click until a separate Enter key press; the entry click was not treated as the explicit start that FPS_INTERACTION_UX and INPUT_CONTROLS specify.

Secondary: transaction safe pauses (toggleFixed, place, KeyL) called suspend(), clearing the host's pointerLocked while the browser still owned the lock, so an explicit Enter Resume afterwards failed.

afterFix.observed: Entry click -> running (tick 41) with lock CANVAS and no Enter; F fixes ball -> paused with lock kept; Enter -> running; W 1 s + mouse -> z 4 -> 2.502, yaw changed; Enter pause; click resume; Esc -> unlocked/paused; click view after 1.3 s -> relocked and running; 0 OnThrow events; 0 console errors.
